requirements.statement: Supported local runtime capabilities are explicit, versioned, and fail closed when external provider or hook capability is unknown.
Repository-owned install, compatibility, adoption, upgrade, and migration paths are reproducible and preserve rollback evidence.
Mission execution schedules only ordinary governed KEEL Changes in isolated worktrees with bounded, recoverable retry state.

Mission execution cannot bypass Change scope or effects, grant authorization, fabricate evidence, weaken verification, seal unverified material, substitute Git state, or evade these checks through alternate dispatch paths.
